meta.name: add-dial
meta.description: Add Dial channel integration — a real phone number for SMS and AI voice calls via the Dial platform (getdial.ai). Native adapter — no Chat SDK bridge.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 给应用接入真实号码,支持短信与AI语音通话
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果正在开发需要电话或短信能力的应用
copy.tagline_en: Add a real phone number for SMS and AI voice calls to your app
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you're building an app that needs phone or SMS capabilities

howto.what: 它会为你的 Claude 接入 Dial 平台的一个真实电话号码,用来收发短信和接打 AI 语音电话。安装时复制 Dial 适配器、配对助手和测试,装 qrcode 依赖并构建,再用 dial CLI 登录、选号、注册线路,并用一次性验证码配对手机。
howto.when: 当你要给 agent 加一个 Dial 真实电话号码(短信和 AI 语音通话)并运行本安装技能时进入:依次走登录 Dial、选号、注册线路、配对手机这套流程。

say.text: 帮我接入 Dial,给 agent 一个真实电话号码
say.note: 会复制适配器、装依赖并构建

say.text: 把这条 Dial 线路设成 owner,只有我的手机能联系 agent
say.note: 注册线路时写入 strict 策略

say.text: 改一下 Dial 线路接听来电时的问候语
say.note: 更新该号码的拨入 AI 提示词

howto.what_en: It gives your Claude a real Dial phone number for SMS and AI voice calls. Install copies the Dial adapter and pairing helper, adds qrcode, builds, then uses the dial CLI to sign in, pick a number, register the line and pair your phone.
howto.when_en: Use when you want to add a real Dial phone number (SMS and AI voice calls) to your agent and run this install skill; it walks through Dial sign-in, number selection, line registration and phone pairing.

say_en.text: Set up Dial and give my agent a real phone number
say_en.note: Copies the adapter, installs deps and builds

say_en.text: Make this Dial line owner-only so just my phone reaches the agent
say_en.note: Registers the line with a strict sender policy

say_en.text: Change the greeting my Dial line uses for incoming calls
say_en.note: Sets the number's inbound AI instruction
